metadata.name: timber-peg-slider
metadata.description: iOS-optimized, touch-friendly before-and-after comparison slider with a hand-carved wood peg handle.
features: Pointer events touch control with setPointerCapture for smooth iOS WebKit scrolling without bounce
Left and Right media support for HTML5 Video or Image with autoplay and cover fit
Hand-carved wooden peg handle with radial grain texture and mortise/tenon icon indicator
Customizable top badges and floating right side overlay card with title, subtext, and CTA button
Exposes component reactive state for current position (0-100%) and callable workflow actions

properties.name: initialPosition
properties.description: Initial position percentage of the slider (0-100).

properties.name: beforeType
properties.description: Media type for left layer ('video' or 'image').

properties.name: beforeVideoUrl
properties.description: Video URL for the Left (Before) layer.

properties.name: beforeImageUrl
properties.description: Image URL for the Left (Before) layer.

properties.name: beforeBadgeText
properties.description: Label text for the top-left badge.

properties.name: afterType
properties.description: Media type for right layer ('image' or 'video').

properties.name: afterImageUrl
properties.description: Image URL for the Right (After) layer.

properties.name: afterVideoUrl
properties.description: Video URL for the Right (After) layer.

properties.name: afterBadgeText
properties.description: Label text for the top-right badge.

properties.name: showOverlay
properties.description: Whether to display the right side floating card.

properties.name: overlayTitle
properties.description: Heading text inside the right floating card.

properties.name: overlaySubtext
properties.description: Body paragraph inside the right floating card.
properties.defaultValue: Reclaiming century-old timber with reverence and care, Bear spent two full winters hand-milling every beam.

properties.name: showCta
properties.description: Whether to display the CTA button in the floating card.

properties.name: dividerColor
properties.description: Hex or CSS color for vertical divider line.

properties.name: pegBgDark
properties.description: Dark wood color gradient step for peg handle.

properties.name: pegBgLight
properties.description: Light wood color gradient step for peg handle.

properties.name: pegBorderColor
properties.description: Accent border color for the wooden peg.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: Main container border radius CSS length.

events.name: sliderChange
events.description: Fired whenever the user drags or taps to change the split position.

events.name: ctaClick
events.description: Fired when the CTA button inside the right overlay card is clicked.

actions.label: Set Slider Position
actions.description: Programmatically sets the slider position between 0 and 100.

args.name: position
args.description: Position value from 0 (all After) to 100 (all Before).

actions.label: Reset Position
actions.description: Resets the slider position back to the initialPosition property value.

variables.name: sliderPosition
variables.description: Current position percentage of the slider handle (0 to 100).

specifications: Width is fluid (100%), capped at max-width 1000px by default.
Desktop aspect ratio defaults to 16/9, on narrower mobile screens min-height 500px or aspect-ratio 4/5 is applied.
Utilizes pointer events with setPointerCapture and touch-action: none to allow responsive dragging on iOS WebKit without page scroll conflicts.
Right layer is revealed using CSS clip-path inset so both Left and Right media maintain full 100% dimensions and cover fit without layout distortion.

examples.description: Default Timber Peg Slider setup with carpenter video on left and sanctuary barn on right.
